page.overview:
Who is Betsy?

When Lisa wanted to get a toy dolphin at the store, she asks the clerk if she can have it be a dolphin, the clerk refused to give Betsy a dolphin outfit because it was a girl. Lisa eventually tells the clerk it is a boy dolphin, which the clerk apologizes to Lisa for, and gives her the outfit she asked for. Lisa then turned around and giggled, because Betsy was actually a female.

The store where Lisa got Betsy is a parody of Build-a-Bear.
